goal: Support unloading and reloading a registered tool through ToolRegistry.unregister(name: str) -> ToolDefinition. The removed registration disappears from future lookups and definitions, while already-started calls retain their original handler. Preserve the accepted definition snapshot ownership and all existing tool behavior. Add meaningful tests only in the approved new file.
deliverable: Scoped implementation passing complete checks, fresh review and independent acceptance.

reasons: Public plugin lifecycle, in-flight invocation identity and removal/re-registration boundaries.

required_behavior.text: Add unregister(name: str) -> ToolDefinition. Removing an existing registered name returns its original metadata as a normal mutable independent snapshot and removes it from subsequent definitions and invoke lookups. Remaining tools stay in stable sorted order and continue working. Previously returned snapshots remain independent.
Unknown-name removal raises the existing ToolNotFoundError and does not change the registry; no exact exception-message requirement.

An invocation whose original handler has already started is not cancelled or redirected by removal or re-registration. New lookup after removal raises ToolNotFoundError; after the same name is registered again, new invocation uses the replacement handler and new discovery metadata. This task does not promise multi-threaded atomicity or stop side effects of an already-running handler.

Preserve existing register/definitions/invoke signatures, ownership behavior, validation, hooks, timeouts and errors. Do not change protected tests, dependencies or external I/O. Supplemental assertions must follow these public behaviors, not exact error messages or incidental implementation shape.

acceptance_criteria.text: All project checks, protected lifecycle tests, fresh Reviewer and independent Primary acceptance must pass.

required_order: An already-started invocation retains the original registration through completion while future lookup observes removal/re-registration.
forbidden_orderings: Do not cancel or redirect an already-started invocation as a side effect of unregister; do not allow future invocation of a removed registration before replacement.

acceptance_scenarios.text: Remove one tool, preserve another and sorted discovery.
Unknown removal raises stable error without mutation.
Same name re-registers with new metadata/handler;old snapshot and running call remain original.
